children: Forge Nano reported net income in the quarter, driven by a $37.5M gain from the change in fair value of its PIPE subscription derivative liability, partly offset by $20K in general and administrative expenses. The filing reports no operating revenue to date.
: Forge Nano completed its business combination on Oct. 22, 2026, after the quarter ended.
: The company issued $100M of securities to an investor and raised an additional $23M from other investors at closing.
: After closing, management concluded it had sufficient liquidity to fund obligations and planned operations for at least 12 months.
